name: Ocal Browser v9.8.05 (Stable)
body:
## 🚀 Ocal Browser v9.8.05 (Stable) — Release Notes

### 🛡️ Microsoft Store & Security Compliance
* **Store Policy 10.2.9 Hardening**: Purged all internal private certificate references and background trust elevation scripts from the installer payload.
* **Fresh Authenticode Signature**: Re-signed binary executables and installer with refreshed Gaming Network Studio SHA-256 certificate and RFC 3161 DigiCert timestamping.
* **Dual Packaging Format**: Produced both standalone Inno Setup EXE and Microsoft Store-compliant MSIX/AppX packages.

### 🎨 AI Settings & UI Polish
* **AI Settings Panel Refinements**: Cleaned input fields and eliminated double-border artifacts across Light & Dark themes.
* **Sidebar Animations**: Polished closing transitions and optimized startup loading sequences.

### ⚡ Performance & Hardware Acceleration
* **Passthrough Command Decoder & Direct3D 11**: Direct GPU driver compositing without emulation layers for low latency and zero-copy rendering.
